API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIAppProtection Profile ManagementUpdates the App Protection profile for the specified ID and dissociates all predefined controls from a profile. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
Updates the App Protection profile for the specified ID and dissociates all predefined controls from a profile. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionProfile/:inspectionProfileId/deAssociateAllPredefinedControls
DEPRECATED

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

Updates the App Protection profile for the specified ID and dissociates all predefined controls from a profile. This API will be deprecated in a future release.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

inspectionProfileId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the AppProtection profile.

400
401
403
